contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= n <= 10**5","description":"The number of stones n must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= b_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= c_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i in stones)","description":"Each dimension of the stones must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"k in {1, 2}","description":"The number of stones chosen k must be either 1 or 2."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"len(set(chosen_stones)) == k","description":"The chosen stones must be distinct and their count must match k."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"stdout == f'{k}\\n{" ".join(map(str, chosen_stones))}'","description":"The output must correctly format the number of stones and their indices."}],"invariants":[]}
